tokens.--color-surface: subtle background for panels, table heads, footers
tokens.--color-text-secondary: body text of cards and panels
tokens.--color-on-primary: text on primary or danger fills
tokens.--leading-tight: line height for headings and controls
tokens.--grid-min: minimum column width in .grid; override inline per grid

baseStyles.note: Base styles apply --font-sans, --color-text and --color-background to the page and the --text-* scale to h1–h4. Override the tokens to restyle.

layouts.container: centered page-width wrapper with side padding
layouts.cluster: wrapping row of small items (tags, buttons, links)
layouts.grid: responsive equal columns, as many as fit (min --grid-min)
layouts.sidebar: 1st child narrow side panel, 2nd child main area; stacks when narrow
layouts.sidebar-end: with a sidebar class: last child is the narrow column (right), 1st child the main area
layouts.split: two groups pushed to opposite ends of a row; wraps when tight
layouts.center: readable, horizontally centered column of text
layouts.cover: full-viewport-height section, main child vertically centered
layouts.cover-main: the child of .cover that is vertically centered

variants.button-primary: main action of a form or page

field.intent: one labeled form control with help or error text

parts.card-body: main content; grows to align footers
parts.card-footer: bottom bar on the surface color
parts.card-actions: wrapping row of buttons or links

panel.intent: flat bordered group of secondary content

parts.panel-header: title area with a bottom border

parts.table-wrap: bordered wrapper that scrolls wide tables; add tabindex="0"

empty-state.intent: nothing to show yet: icon, heading, text, action

recommended: Wrap each page in .container and give it a .stack or .stack-lg.
Nest primitives: .split for headers, .cluster for button rows, .grid of .card for collections.
Combine a component part with a layout primitive on one element, e.g. class="card-footer split".
Put components on native elements: <button>, <a href>, <table>, <label> + <input>.
avoid: Margins between siblings; spacing comes from gap variants.
Wrapper <div>s that add no layout intent.
Restyling a component with extra CSS; override tokens on :root instead.
Classes for state (is-active, disabled); use attributes.
Visual reordering (order, *-reverse); DOM order is visual order.

generationRules: Use only the classes and tokens in this contract; never invent class names.
Build structure from layout primitives and nest them; never write custom flex or grid CSS.
Set spacing with the -sm / -lg gap variants, never with margins or utility classes.
Never use inline styles except a token override such as style="--grid-min: 12rem".
In any custom CSS, reference tokens with var(); never hard-code colors, px/rem sizes, shadows or durations.
Put components on semantic native elements and keep one component per element.
Express state with attributes: disabled, aria-disabled="true", aria-busy="true", aria-invalid="true".
Pick variants by meaning, not look: button-danger for destructive actions, badge-success for success.
Write no media queries or breakpoint classes; primitives adapt to the space they get.
Keep it accessible: aria-label on .button-icon, role="status" or role="alert" on .alert, a <label for> on every control.
